 EPFO Launches WhatsApp Service: Check PF Balance, Passbook and Transactions
 EPFO , Latest , Top Story 
 EPFO has introduced a WhatsApp-based service for employees and pensioners, allowing them to access provident fund information and other services directly from their smartphones.
 Highlights
 EPFO introduces WhatsApp services on its 74th anniversary.
 Members can check their PF balance through WhatsApp.
 Users can download their EPF passbook and view their last five transactions.
 The reported WhatsApp service number is 8796441800.
 OTP verification is required to access account information.
 Members are advised not to share UAN credentials, passwords or OTPs.
 EPFO WhatsApp Service: Check PF Balance, Download Passbook and View Transactions on Your Phone
 New Delhi, November 3: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has reportedly introduced a WhatsApp-based service to make provident fund-related information more accessible to employees and pensioners. The initiative comes as the organisation marks its 74th anniversary and aims to simplify access to essential EPF account services.
 According to a report by The Economic Times Hindi, members can use the service to check their provident fund balance, download passbook details and review their five most recent transactions without navigating multiple online portals.
 What Services Are Available?
 The reported WhatsApp facility allows EPFO members to access several account-related services through a familiar messaging platform.
 Employees can check whether their monthly PF contributions have been credited, view their account balance and obtain passbook information.
 Members can also access their last five transactions and seek information about eligibility and services under the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY).
 How to Check PF Balance Through WhatsApp
 According to the report, members can follow these steps:
 Open WhatsApp and contact the reported EPFO service number, 8796441800, or scan the official QR code.
 Send “Hi” to initiate the conversation.
 Select the preferred language.
 Choose the PF balance, passbook or transaction history option.
 Complete the required OTP verification.
 Select the relevant account and member ID to access the requested information.
 Members selecting the passbook option may also be able to download their EPF account details directly to their smartphones.
 Important Safety Precautions
 EPFO members should exercise caution while accessing financial information through messaging platforms.
 Users must never share their Universal Account Number (UAN) password, OTP or other confidential credentials with unknown individuals.
 They should also avoid suspicious links and verify the WhatsApp number through EPFO’s official website before sharing account-related information.
 Digital Services for EPFO Members
 The reported initiative could make PF account management more convenient, particularly for employees who prefer accessing services through mobile applications.
 By bringing balance enquiries, passbook information and transaction details to WhatsApp, EPFO aims to reduce the need for members to visit offices or navigate separate digital platforms for routine enquiries.
 Note: The WhatsApp number and availability of these features are based on the supplied November 2 report and have not been independently verified against an official EPFO announcement.
